headline: New Update! - version 1.2.0
openingRemarks: Leveling changes, consumables items, and Photon Tokens!

newFeatures.title: Leveling Changes
newFeatures.description: The XP gained for activities remains the same, however the time it takes to level up has increased a moderate amount, depending on level. Additionally, Power is no longer acquired with activities and now is gained at a rate of 5 per level. Max health will also be gained this way. Armor, Recovery, and the elements remain unchanged. Quantum points must be reset by taking the 'Retrocausal Capsule in your inventory.

newFeatures.title: Consumables Items
newFeatures.description: One-time use items are now in HeroFit! Every player has been granted one 'Retrocausal Capsule' to reset their stats, but more items can be purchased with Photon Tokens when you click 'buy' in the inventory.

newFeatures.title: Photon Tokens
newFeatures.description: The new in-game currency is here! PT is earned mostly through winning battles, but in the future may come from activities too. Spend your PT by going to the inventory page and clicking 'Buy'.

bugFixes: Battle history on the user profile page is now showing up in reverse chronological order
General workouts were showing 'NaN' on the Training page. This is resolved
Fixed bug with showing and clicking item rewards on the 'Go to Battle' window
balanceChanges: New users now only receive their previous 5 activities. This is to account for the initial hero levels being easier to achieve under the new XP curve
Phantom & Phantasm now will only trade their health/armor with yours if you have the higher value to being with. Previously, these dim-witted ghosts would make bad deals for themselves
miscDetails: Big improvements to various window UIs and more content is visible within the windows
Battle Report Detail window is now easier to understand
Certain alerts are now clickable, this will be handy if I need to include links on things such as server-wide messages
Updating hero names from the account page now uses the same availability check as is on the select-hero page
closingRemarks: I understand this patch has some drastic changes, and I appreciate your understanding. These balance changes really needed to happen sooner rather than later, and HeroFit will be better off because of it!
